body.x: The Consumer Technology Association (CTA)TM today announced its Call for Proposals for CES AsiaTM 2017. The premier event for the consumer tech industry in China is returning to Shanghai, June 7-9, 2017. The CES Asia conference program features over 40 hours of programming and more than 100 highly sought after industry experts from around the globe who will provide insights on the latest industry trends and innovations. Proposals can be submitted via this form.

“The CES Asia conference program provides speakers exposure to more than 30,000 attendees, including more than 1,100 members of the global media,” said Gary Shapiro, president and CEO, CTA. “The fast-growing technology tradeshow is an ideal platform to engage in discussions crucial to the advancement of consumer tech in the Asian marketplace. We look forward to hearing from the best and brightest in the industry on the CES Asia stage.”

CES Asia is currently accepting proposals framed with an industry-only audience in mind. CES Asia will select the best candidates based on thought leadership in the industry, diverse perspectives and previous speaking experience. Notifications will be sent out by February 28, 2017. Before submitting a proposal, please review the submission guidelines and speaker overview.
